quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: You can carefully drive through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: An emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when a yellow light appears, you should continue through carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: You can drive around the gates at a railroad crossing:

options.text: When other drivers drive around the gates.

questions.explanation: You must stop at all railroad crossings when signals warn of a train. Warning signs include flashing red lights, lowered crossing gates, a person signaling, or the sound of a train. Never go around a lowered gate.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and give the right-of-way to others.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and give the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and give the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: You cannot safely pass on a two-way, two-lane road unless:

options.text: You can clearly see the road ahead.
You can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic.
Your vehicle is fast enough to pass.

questions.explanation: You cannot safely pass on a two-way, two-lane road unless all three conditions are met: you can see the road ahead clearly, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic, and your vehicle can go fast enough to pass. Do not pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: Driving at night compared to driving during the day is:
questions.explanation: Driving at night is more dangerous than driving during the day. You cannot see as well in the dark, headlights from other cars can blind you, and more tired or impaired drivers are on the road at night.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead is a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: Downward-facing triangular signs mean:
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. Wait until the road is clear of traffic and pedestrians before you proceed.

questions.question: When you see flashing signals at a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Stop and look for a train.
Slow down and look for a train.
Look for a train, then speed up.
Do what the car ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train.
questions.explanation: When you see a signal warning of a train, stop at least 15 feet away from the nearest rail. Watch for other warning signs like lowered gates or the sound of a train.

questions.question: Crosswalks are:

options.text: Either marked with lines or unmarked.

questions.correctAnswerText: Either marked with lines or unmarked.
questions.explanation: Crosswalks exist with or without painted lines. Drivers must stop behind the crosswalk to let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a traffic signal ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or slow down for a yellow light. Watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: Why should you not follow other cars too closely?

options.text: You may not see the road between the cars.
You may not have time to stop if the car in front of you stops suddenly.
You may not see the vehicle's turn signals.
You may not see the other vehicle's brake lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not have time to stop if the car in front of you stops suddenly.
questions.explanation: If you follow too closely and the car in front stops suddenly, you may not have enough time to stop and could crash.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than day driving?

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night.
You cannot see as far in the dark.
It is more likely to rain at night.
You are more likely to see a motorcycle at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you can see less distance ahead. Always use your headlights. Drive slowly enough that you can stop within the distance you can see.

questions.question: What are signs that show information about dangerous road conditions called?
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about possible hazards ahead. Follow these signs to stay safe. Ignoring a warning sign could cause an accident.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only on the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Only in front of your vehicle.

questions.explanation: Keep space on all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not drive close to vehicles on your left or right.

questions.question: If another driver cuts you off in traffic, what should you do?

options.text: Pull next to the driver and yell.
Cut them off to get back at them.

questions.explanation: Do not take it personally if another driver cuts you off. Let it go and keep driving safely. This helps avoid road rage.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when needed.
Get to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and honk to alert drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each time you pass, there is more risk of a crash. If you drive faster than others, you will need to pass more often. Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only when necessary.

questions.question: If you are driving near a motorcycle, what must you do?

options.text: Give the motorcycle the full lane.
Drive on the shoulder beside the motorcycle.
Share the lane with the motorcycle.
Pass using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle the full lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are full-size vehicles with the same rights as any other vehicle. Give a motorcycle a full lane width. It needs room to move safely, even if it looks like there is room to share.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: Checking your blind spot by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes or merging is:

options.text: Not necessary if you use your rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: Always check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: What should you do when entering a roadway from a private road?

options.text: Use your horn to warn other drivers you are entering.
Stop with part of your car on the roadway to alert other drivers.
Drive out fast to blend in with traffic.
Yield to pedestrians and traffic on the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to pedestrians and traffic on the roadway.
questions.explanation: When entering a roadway from a driveway or private road, you must let pedestrians and roadway traffic go first.

questions.question: A sign of a drunk driver is:
questions.explanation: Signs of drunk driving include weaving, driving slower than traffic, jerking motions, and sudden stops.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead and you should slow down.

questions.question: To reduce headlight glare at night, you should look:

options.text: At the center of the road.
To the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver does not dim their lights, look at the right edge of the road. Do not look directly at the bright headlights, as the glare can blind you.

questions.question: When you see a railroad crossing warning sign:

options.text: Be ready to drive faster than the train.
Be ready to stop if a train is nearby.
Look for a way around lowered gates.
Assume no trains are nearby and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is nearby.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs tell you a train might be coming. Always obey these signs and never go around barriers.

questions.question: A steady yellow light means:

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection, continue through carefully.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay on the side shown by the arrow.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection go first.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to give vehicles and pedestrians time to move.
Must honk your horn so traffic knows to get out of your way.
Must stop and only proceed when no pedestrians or vehicles are coming.
Can ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and only proceed when no pedestrians or vehicles are coming.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the roadway from a driveway and yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians. You must stop before crossing the sidewalk. Not stopping is illegal.

questions.question: Drivers should try to see ____ ahead on the road.
questions.explanation: Good drivers look 10 to 15 seconds ahead. This helps you avoid sudden stops or quick lane changes.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp turn. Slow down before you reach the sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: When should you increase your following distance?

options.text: When driving behind a large vehicle that blocks your view.

questions.explanation: Increase your following distance behind large vehicles that block your view, on expressway exits, behind motorcycles or bicycles, and when someone is tailgating you.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a multi-lane intersection. Oncoming traffic blocks your view. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up as soon as the first lane clears.
Wait until you can see all lanes are clear before turning.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across.
Move into each lane as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all lanes are clear before turning.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn until you can see that all lanes you need to cross are clear and safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light is a warning of a hazard ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.
